$comment: Model aliases by tier, plus the permission reviewer's chain. Aliases cannot target other aliases, so every entry is a concrete model. claude-bridge refuses system prompts it has not captured from a real pi session, which is why it is dead weight in `reviewer` and safe in the session tiers. `reviewer` allows a model 15s to first event, not the 30s default: a stalled reviewer holds up a permission prompt, while a session turn can afford the wait.
